code:
CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE usp_GetOrderTotals
    @IncludeTax BIT = 0
AS
BEGIN
-    SELECT OrderId, SUM(LineTotal) AS Total
+    SELECT OrderId,
+       SUM(LineTotal) * CASE WHEN @IncludeTax=1
+       THEN 1.08 ELSE 1 END AS Total
    FROM OrderLines
    GROUP BY OrderId
END
caption: Exactly one procedure changed, exactly what changed — nothing else.
